Work with GitHub Actions workflows

## Usage

`circleci actions <command> [flags]`

## General Commands

| Command   | Description                                              |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `migrate` | Copy a GitHub Actions workflow into .circleci/workflows/ |

## Flags

Global flags: `-c, --config`, `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Details

Commands for working with GitHub Actions workflows alongside CircleCI.

Use these commands to migrate GitHub Actions workflow files into a
layout that CircleCI can run directly.
